highlights.title: Talk to your agents
highlights.line: On a Mac, press the mic in any message box to speak, or the speaker on an agent's message to hear it. It stays on your computer.

highlights.title: Make a whole team at once
highlights.line: New Agent now asks if you want one agent or a team. Pick a ready-made team of 2 to 6 and Kosmos makes them all in one go.

highlights.title: Put work on hold
highlights.line: Hold a task or pause a project, and the Prompter and the Assigner leave it alone until you take it off hold.

highlights.title: Room posts arrive faster
highlights.line: A post in a project room now reaches every member at once, instead of one after another.

highlights.title: One Kosmos per computer
highlights.line: Kosmos no longer shows a list of Kosmoses. The top left now names this computer.
